newsitem.title: CHINA: China acetic acid firm gets $80 mln foreign loa.
newsitem.headline: China acetic acid firm gets $80 mln foreign loa.

text.p: China's largest acetic acid producer, the Yangtze River Acetyl Chemical Corp, has obtained $80 million in loans from overseas banks, the Xinhua news agency said.

The company, a Sino-British joint venture based in the Chongqing city in southwestern Sichuan province, on Monday signed an agreement on the loans with the Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corp, Japan's Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd and Fuji Bank Ltd, Xinhua said late on Tuesday.
It did not say what the interest rates were nor name the British companies involved.
Total investment in the venture would reach 2.1 billion yuan ($253 million), making it the largest Sino-foreign joint venture in Chongqing, it said.
The project would have production capacity of 150,000 tonnes of acetic acid products annually when completed in 1998, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
